description: This file defines the EndpointV2Middleware class within the AWS SDK for PHP, responsible for handling endpoint rule evaluation and endpoint resolution as middleware during request building. It manages parameters, authentication schemes, and endpoint resolution logic.

classes.name: Aws\EndpointV2\EndpointV2Middleware
classes.description: Middleware class for AWS endpoint resolution, handling parameters, authentication schemes, and endpoint endpoint resolution during request building.

methods.name: Aws\EndpointV2\EndpointV2Middleware::wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware wrapper function that initializes EndpointV2Middleware with provided dependencies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for EndpointV2Middleware, initializing handler, endpoint provider, service API, client arguments, and credential provider.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware to process a command, resolve endpoint, and apply authentication schemes.

methods.name: resolveArgs
methods.description: Resolves and merges command and context parameters for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: filterEndpointCommandArgs
methods.description: Filters command arguments to include only relevant parameters for endpoint provider, considering service-specific options.

methods.name: bindStaticContextParams
methods.description: Binds static context parameters to their static values.

methods.name: bindContextParams
methods.description: Binds runtime context parameters from command arguments.

methods.name: bindOperationContextParams
methods.description: Binds operation-specific context parameters using JMESPath search on command arguments.

methods.name: applyAuthScheme
methods.description: Applies authentication scheme details to the command's context.

methods.name: resolveAuthScheme
methods.description: Selects the first valid auth scheme from the endpoint's auth schemes.

methods.name: normalizeAuthScheme
methods.description: Normalizes an auth scheme into recognized SDK keys.

methods.name: isValidAuthScheme
methods.description: Checks if an auth scheme name is supported, considering extension availability for 'sigv4a'.

methods.name: resolveAccountId
methods.description: Resolves AccountId parameter via credentials provider if not disabled.
